title: Analyzing cytokine-induced growth arrest
protocol: Seed the different cancer cells at a density of 10,000 cells/cm².
Incubate the cells overnight at 37°C; 5% CO₂ to ensure adherence.
Treat the cells with either control medium or cytokines (standard concentration: 100 ng/ml IFN-γ plus 10 ng/ml TNF) for 4 - 5 days.
Remove the medium and trypsinize the cells after treatment.
Count viable cells using trypan blue exclusion under a Zeiss Axiovert 25 microscope with a Neubauer counting-chamber.
Reseed the cells at 20,000 cells/cm² in the absence of cytokines.
Grow the cells in complete RPMI 1640 medium until control cultures reach confluence.
After passage 1 - 2 (p1 - p2), seed 1,000 - 3,000 viable cells on MultiscreenTM HTS 96 well Filtration Plates.
Incubate the cells overnight at 37°C; 5% CO₂ to ensure adherence.
Measure proliferation by BrdU-based Cell Proliferation ELISA in combination with Vector®SG Substrate Kit for Peroxidase to visualize BrdU-incorporating cell clusters.
Count BrdU-positive spots with an ELISPOT reader.
